title: Morinda Closes and the Lakhmi Narayan Episode Opens

blocks.text: This transition page first records the last shadows of Morinda's punishment. Those who had taken refuge in Hindu households are turned out under cover of night, while Jaani Khan and Maani Khan remain fixed in memory as the brothers tied to the arrest of the younger Sahibzadas.

The narrator then closes the Morinda account with the Guru's judgment and an explicit statement that Rattan Singh has narrated what he heard. That closure gives the massacre an ending in testimony as well as in action.

Before the page is done, however, a new episode opens around Lakhmi Narayan Kshtriya, a revenue officer whose movements and wealth draw Khalsa attention in the Doaba. The page therefore works as a hinge, ending one vengeance narrative and launching the next campaign of expropriation.
